purpose: Verify Quebrada La Polvareda, Quebrada La Pólvora and Quebrada Higos Monte (Pisco, Ica) in archived documents and record them in the national master inventory as documentary identities only. Two labels are not assumed to be one channel, and proposed works are not executed works or events.

provenance.requested_by: Project owner, 2026-10-09 (for independent scientific QA by ChatGPT)
provenance.quote_rule: Every quote is a whitespace-normalised verbatim substring of the archived text layer of the cited page; tests re-check it against files whose SHA-256 matches the manifest.
provenance.visual_check: Study pp. 5-6 and Plan p. 64 rendered with pdftoppm and read by eye (Claude, 2026-10-09); printed page labels equal PDF page numbers on the pages checked.
provenance.repo_check: git grep on main and on every remote branch history, and the diffs of all open PRs: no quebrada La Polvareda, La Pólvora or Higos Monte in Ica. Only unrelated homonyms (see homonyms_and_non_channel_uses).

EST-P1-COVER-CONVENIO.text: CONVENIO GOBIERNO REGIONAL DE ICA - AUTORIDAD NACIONAL DEL AGUA

EST-P1-COVER-TITLE.text: AFIANZAMIENTO HÍDRICO EN LA CUENCA DEL RÍO PISCO (Provincias Pisco-Ica / Región Ica) ESTUDIO A NIVEL DE FACTIBILIDAD VOLUMEN I EL PROYECTO MARZO 2011

EST-P4-TWO-STORAGES.text: Se plantea por lo tanto dos almacenamientos: uno artificial a ser construido mediante una presa en la Qda. La Polvareda y otro natural conformado por el sistema acuífero de Río Seco

EST-P5-WORKS-PROPOSED.text: Las obras planteadas por el Proyecto son:

EST-P5-POLVAREDA.text: a ser construida en una quebrada seca (Qda. La Polvareda), que desemboca en el río Pisco a la altura de Cerro Colorado en el distrito de Humay, Pisco.

EST-P5-POLVORA.text: instalado sobre la quebrada de Río Seco, tomando los ramales que drenan hacia Villacurí y el ramal del norte denominado Qda. La Pólvora que drena hacia Lanchas.

EST-P5-BOCATOMA.text: Una bocatoma sobre la margen izquierda del río Pisco, a la altura de la localidad de Huáncano, para un caudal de 30 m3/s.

EST-P5-CANAL-POLVAREDA.locator: sistema de alimentación, canal de conducción
EST-P5-CANAL-POLVAREDA.text: Canal de conducción, que trasladará los 30 m3/s hacia la Qda. La Polvareda en donde dejará 15 m3/s para el llenado del embalse

EST-P5-HIGOS-MONTE.text: Desarenador en la Qda. Higos Monte a 4 540 m de la bocatoma, diseñado para procesar concentraciones de 0,50 g/l hasta niveles de partículas de 0,20 mm, para 30 m3/s.

EST-P6-FIGURE-TITLE.text: Figura 1: Esquema de Distribución de las Obras

EST-P6-FIGURE-HIGOSMONTE.locator: Figura 1, rótulo junto a «Desarenador» (visto en la página renderizada)

EST-P9-SCHEDULE.text: A partir del tercer año, y en paralelo con las obras descritas anteriormente, empiezan las obras de la Presa La Polvareda y el Desarenador Higos Monte.

EST-P19-CONCLUSION.text: hasta la Qda. La Polvareda en donde se dejan 15 m3/s para el llenado del embalse de 80 Hm3 y 15 m3/s siguen hacia la Qda. Río Seco

classification_vocabulary.IDENTITY_ONLY: Named as a quebrada in archived documents; no event, geometry or outlet evidence.
classification_vocabulary.GEOMETRY_PENDING: Here: no reproducible channel or catchment geometry exists yet. In the national audit vocabulary GEOMETRY_PENDING also requires a geometry lead (faja resolution or frozen geometry); none exists, so the audit rows carry IDENTITY_ONLY only.
classification_vocabulary.OUTLET_PENDING: Here: no reproducible outlet or confluence point exists. A textual description of where a quebrada meets a river is recorded as source text, not as an outlet.

maturity_vocabulary.M2_TWO_DOCUMENTS_SAME_PROJECT: Named in two archived documents that describe the same project; not independent observations of the channel.

administrative_basis.reading: The study places the point where the quebrada meets the río Pisco 'a la altura de Cerro Colorado en el distrito de Humay, Pisco'. The district is stated for that location, not for the whole channel.

hydrologic_context_in_source.text: Dry quebrada that 'desemboca en el río Pisco a la altura de Cerro Colorado'.

works_named_in_sources.work: Presa / embalse La Polvareda (80 Hm3) and canal de entrega to the río Pisco
works_named_in_sources.note: Ley 31070 (2020) declares the dam project of public interest; a declaration is not execution.

candidates.independence_note: The Plan de Competitividad (GORE Ica, 2013) lists the same project; it is not an independent observation of the channel.
candidates.location_note: Source: dry quebrada that meets the río Pisco 'a la altura de Cerro Colorado en el distrito de Humay, Pisco' (GORE Ica-ANA 2011, p. 5). Recorded as source text; not adopted as outlet or parent basin. The label also names the proposed dam project (Ley 31070) and a farmers' association (Plan de Competitividad p. 72).
candidates.event_note: No source read describes a flow, huaico, flood or any other event in this quebrada; no event is attributed.

administrative_basis.reading: No province or district is stated for this quebrada; Lanchas is named only as the direction it drains to. Not inferred.

hydrologic_context_in_source.text: 'el ramal del norte denominado Qda. La Pólvora que drena hacia Lanchas', within the recharge system 'instalado sobre la quebrada de Río Seco'.

works_named_in_sources.work: Recharge system (pozas de infiltración) on the quebrada de Río Seco, taking the branches toward Villacurí and the Qda. La Pólvora branch

candidates.independence_note: Named once, in one document hosted by a third party.
candidates.location_note: Source: 'el ramal del norte denominado Qda. La Pólvora que drena hacia Lanchas', part of the recharge system on the quebrada de Río Seco (GORE Ica-ANA 2011, p. 5). District not stated. Relation to Río Seco recorded as source text only; not adopted as parent system. Possible equivalence with La Polvareda UNRESOLVED.
candidates.event_note: No source read describes a flow, huaico, flood or any other event in this quebrada; no event is attributed.

administrative_basis.reading: No province or district is stated. The desilter site is given only as 4 540 m from the intake (bocatoma at Huáncano, left bank of the río Pisco). Not inferred.

hydrologic_context_in_source.text: Site of the proposed desarenador on the conduction canal, 4 540 m from the bocatoma; the source does not state what the quebrada drains to.

candidates.independence_note: Named in one document hosted by a third party (text, figure and cost tables of the same study).
candidates.location_note: Source: 'Desarenador en la Qda. Higos Monte a 4 540 m de la bocatoma' (bocatoma on the left bank of the río Pisco at Huáncano; GORE Ica-ANA 2011, p. 5). District and drainage not stated; nothing inferred. The figure on p. 6 writes 'Higosmonte'.
candidates.event_note: No source read describes a flow, huaico, flood or any other event in this quebrada; no event is attributed.

possible_equivalences.documentary_observation: The same 2011 study describes La Polvareda as a dry quebrada meeting the río Pisco near Cerro Colorado (Humay) and La Pólvora as the northern branch of the quebrada de Río Seco draining toward Lanchas. The different descriptions are recorded, not adjudicated: a misspelling, two labels for one channel, or two channels all remain possible.
possible_equivalences.needed: Georeferenced hydrography (ANA) or the study's maps/annexes placing both labels.

other_relations_recorded_not_adopted.note: The study calls La Pólvora a branch of the quebrada de Río Seco. Whether that Río Seco is the main unit ica_rio_seco_salas is not adjudicated; no parent system is adopted.
The source gives only the desilter distance from the intake; it does not say what Higos Monte drains to.
